# 2 Clement — Chapter 19 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 19
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So then, brothers and sisters, after the God of truth, I read you an exhortation to attend to the things written, so that both you may save yourselves and the one who reads in your midst.
2. For as a fee I ask of you to repent with your whole heart, granting salvation and life to yourselves. For in doing this, we will lay down a goal for all the young who desire to labor for the sake of piety and the love of God.
3. And let us not, being foolish, be displeased and vexed whenever anyone admonishes us and turns us from unrighteousness to righteousness.
4. For sometimes, as we do evil things, we do not perceive it — because of the double-mindedness and unbelief that dwells in our hearts; and our understanding is darkened by vain desires.
5. Let us practice righteousness, therefore, that we may be saved in the end. Blessed are those who obey these ordinances; even if they endure hardship for a short time in this world, they shall pluck the immortal fruit of the resurrection.
6. Let the godly man not be grieved if he suffers hardship in the present times; a blessed time awaits him.
7. When he comes to life again with the fathers who have been revived, he will rejoice forever and a day in a world that knows no grief, having suffered nothing grievous.
